# Highlight.js 11.12.0

Vendored ES modules for the `demo.php` page. Only the core,
PHP, XML/HTML, and PHP-template grammars are included. No build step or external
network request is needed to render the demo.

Source: https://github.com/highlightjs/cdn-release/tree/11.12.0/build/es

Release: https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js/releases/tag/11.12.0

Original source filenames: `core.min.js`, `languages/php.min.js`,
`languages/xml.min.js`, and `languages/php-template.min.js`.

The upstream BSD 3-Clause license is included in `LICENSE`.
